title: Final Souldown Gold Key Door Skip
instructions: Using a movement speed boosted DuckJump, you skip over to a ledge, bypassing a huge ambush and going directly into the Redstone Monstrosity fight.
notes: You need to double back and touch the space behind the door for the objective to update.
